menu.triggerInAccessibilityTree.reason: Radix's modal menu hides the rest of the page, trigger included, from assistive technology; Foldkit's non-modal menu leaves it in place.

menu.focusModel.reason: Radix moves DOM focus to each item; Foldkit keeps focus on role=menu and tracks the item with aria-activedescendant. Both are ARIA menu patterns.

axe.menuOpen.reason: Radix's modal hiding produces aria-hidden-focus, landmark-one-main and page-has-heading-one; html-has-lang and region come from the bare harness page.

menu.arrowDownWalk.reason: Radix stops at the last item unless loop is set; Foldkit's Menu always wraps.

menu.tabWhileOpen.reason: Known Foldkit defect, drafted upstream: Tab closes the menu without restoring focus, so focus falls to <body>. Remove this entry when the fix lands.
